caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a cross mounted on a staff. The cross is rendered in green with a gold outline and features trefoil ends on each arm. Below the cross is an ornate gold section with scrollwork, followed by a segmented staff that alternates between green and gold bands down its length. The staff is vertically aligned and positioned at the center of an otherwise plain, light beige background. The name "Wm. HOFFMAN" is written in small, black letters towards the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Processional Cross
